Atendimento & Suporte Receber, acompanhar e direcionar demandas dos clientes junto às áreas internas; Garantir o registro e acompanhamento de solicitações, dúvidas e incidentes; Apoiar a resolução de problemas operacionais e funcionais relacionados às plataformas; Contribuir para a construção de materiais de apoio e boas práticas para clientes.  Retenção & Crescimento Identificar oportunidades de expansão de uso das soluções; Apoiar ações de renovação e retenção de clientes; Coletar feedbacks e insights para contribuir com melhorias de produto e processos; Atuar de forma preventiva para reduzir riscos de churn. Atualizar informações em CRM e sistemas internos; Acompanhar métricas relacionadas à satisfação, engajamento e retenção; Elaborar relatórios e análises simples sobre a carteira de clientes; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos da área de Customer Success.  Requisitos Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Atendimento ao Cliente, Suporte ou áreas de relacionamento; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Excel ou Google Sheets; Facilidade para organização e acompanhamento de múltiplas demandas; Perfil proativo, colaborativo e orientado à solução de problemas.  Diferenciais Experiência com plataformas SaaS; Conhecimento em CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce ou similares); Vivência com atendimento B2B; Conhecimento em logística, transporte ou supply chain; Interesse por tecnologia, inovação e inteligência artificial.  O que esperamos de você Na Mobiis, acreditamos que a experiência do cliente é construída todos os dias. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de criar conexões, resolver problemas, aprender continuamente e gerar valor por meio de relacionamentos duradouros. Se você gosta de trabalhar com pessoas, tecnologia e desafios que geram impacto real nos negócios dos clientes, queremos conhecer você. VR e VA em cartão flexível Auxílio Mobilidade ou Vale-Transporte Plano de Saúde Day Off no aniversário Parcerias educacionais, saúde e bem-estar Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com oportunidades de crescimento   #J-18808-Ljbffr

A hora de fazer parte de um time comprometido, acolhedor e que leva saúde para milhões de pessoas, é agora! Estamos na busca de profissionais para compor a nossa equipe! Se você é comprometido(a) e apaixonado(a) por novos desafios, aqui é o seu lugar! Faça seu cadastro e envie seu currículo! Receber o plantão e acompanhar a programação das atividades, verificar os materiais de trabalho e a distribuição das tarefas para a equipe técnica, checar os registros no mapa diário, tomando as devidas providências para solucionar as pendências; Conduzir a equipe de técnicos de enfermagem na assistência aos clientes, acompanhando e supervisionando as atividades diárias; Acolher, prestar orientações e esclarecimentos aos clientes e familiares; Realizar processo de admissão, de alta e de transferência dos clientes; Visitar os clientes internados na unidade, identificando necessidades e pendências para o tratamento; Realizar aprazamento de prescrição médica e administrar medicações; Estabelecer prioridades e orientar a equipe na qualidade da assistência de enfermagem; Realizar a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem; Preparar os clientes para realizarem exames e/ou transferências, quando necessário; Realizar atividades administrativas relativas à solicitação de autorização de exames, agendamentos de exames, transferência de pacientes para UTI ou enfermaria, e outros; Contatar médicos de sobreaviso e /ou especialistas, quando necessário; Monitorar e garantir a utilização de Equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs); Preencher o livro de ocorrência; Registrar no Prontuário eletrônico do paciente (PEP) o histórico de enfermagem, com evolução diária e prescrição médica dos pacientes; Reportar ao enfermeiro líder ou coordenador os resultados do setor, propondo melhorias para o alcance das metas estabelecidas; Conduzir a equipe técnica durante os procedimentos de reanimação, acompanhando o tempo da parada; Acompanhar, supervisionar e notificar os eventos adversos; Acompanhar o recebimento de medicamentos nas unidades; Supervisionar e atuar nos programas de controle sistemático de infecção hospitalar; Manter contato com profissionais de outros setores, sempre que necessário, para alinhamento de processos e procedimentos; Seguir e monitorar a aplicação do Protocolo operacional padrão (POP), sugerindo melhoria nos processos, quando possível; Participar periodicamente de reuniões com a equipe de enfermagem; Planejar ações de melhorias, levantando as necessidades e estabelecendo prioridades para resolução; Capacitar e promover treinamentos em serviço “in-loco” com a equipe de enfermagem; Participar do processo de capacitação, educação permanente e avaliação de desempenho dos profissionais; Contribuir e/ou desenvolver ações de melhoria ao programa de qualidade e segurança no atendimento ao cliente; Verificar o uso e funcionamento dos equipamentos, solicitar manutenção e reparo sempre que necessário, garantindo perfeitas condições de uso; Manter o ambiente de trabalho tranquilo e organizado, verificando a disponibilidade do material necessário, a funcionalidade dos equipamentos, a utilização das vestimentas e indumentárias, a limpeza e a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes e familiares; Manter-se atualizado acerca das tendências técnicas e científicas no campo administrativo e da sua especialidade, bem como no campo das mudanças legais referentes ao COREN, Ministério da Saúde, ANVISA e outras esferas importantes; Cumprir às normas, procedimentos ou instruções de trabalho, conforme sua área de atuação, estabelecidos pela empresa ou legislação em vigor.  Unidade: Hospital Renascença Campinas Requisitos necessários  Superior completo em Enfermagem; Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN).  O que oferecemos?  Plano de Saúde; Vale Alimentação; Parcerias e descontos com Instituições de Ensino; TotalPass (parceria com academias); Plano de Carreira.  Há 80 anos, oferecemos o melhor para cumprir a nossa missão de proporcionar saúde integrada de qualidade e acessível a gerações de brasileiros. Cuidamos com qualidade do bem-estar das pessoas de forma séria, comprometida e socialmente responsável, somando as melhores práticas para oferecer saúde acessível e de qualidade à população brasileira.  Temos o compromisso de promover a diversidade e a inclusão no local de trabalho. Nossos objetivos são pautados na construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, discriminação, assédio moral e sexual, desrespeito, injustiça ou condutas ofensivas. Além disso, buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam seguros para expressar quem realmente são, com igualdade e equidade de oportunidades.  Incentivamos a candidatura de todas as pessoas que se sintam alinhadas ao nosso compromisso de diversidade e à nossa missão de tornar saúde de qualidade acessível aos brasileiros.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026   Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.  Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page   About the Role   Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.  The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.  What You’ll Be Responsible For    Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.  Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.  Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.  Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.  Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.  Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.  Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.  Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   Must-have    +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management.  Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections.  Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).  Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language.  Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions.  A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer.  Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators.    Nice-to-have    Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks.  Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak.  Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure.  Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments.  Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência, é importante apresentar o seu laudo durante o processo seletivo.  Consulte quais dados são necessários conter no laudo clicando aqui. Assim, podemos garantir o suporte e as adaptações que você merece. Se ainda não tem o laudo caracterizador, não se preocupe: podemos te apoiar para obtê-lo. title: Netwrok Engineer (Automation)
description:
Empresa está contratando Netwrok Engineer (Automation) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Summary  The Automation Engineer (L3) is responsible for designing, developing, and operating network automation workflows using iTential as the core platform. This role integrates automation with ServiceNow for ITSM-driven execution (incidents/changes/requests) and establishes a robust CI/CD and version‑control practice using Bitbucket. The engineer partners with network operations and engineering teams to identify high-value use cases, build reusable automation modules, and improve reliability, compliance, and speed of execution across the network estate.  Key Responsibilities   Design and develop automation workflows on iTential for network operations, incident response, and change execution.  Integrate iTential workflows with ServiceNow to enable ticket‑driven automation (e.g., automated change creation/updates, approvals routing, execution status updates, closure evidence).  Build and maintain reusable automation components (templates, modules, libraries) to accelerate delivery and improve standardization.  Establish and operate code versioning, branching, peer‑review, and release practices using Bitbucket (pull requests, code reviews, release tagging).  Implement automation quality gates: unit testing, pre/post validation, rollback logic, and audit artifacts for compliance.  Troubleshoot workflow failures and platform issues; provide L3 escalation support and root‑cause analysis for automation incidents.  Work with network SMEs to translate operational procedures (runbooks/ROC) into safe, automated workflows and policies.  Develop and maintain dashboards/metrics for automation adoption, success rate, failure trends, and business value outcomes.  Support secure automation practices (least privilege, secrets handling, credential rotation where applicable) and alignment to customer controls.  Mentor L2 engineers/analysts, and contribute to automation playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base documentation.    Tools & Platforms (Experience With)   Advanced English  iTential – automation workflow development and orchestration (core platform).  ServiceNow – ITSM integration for Incident / Problem / Change / Request workflows and automation triggering.  Bitbucket – source control management, branching strategy, code reviews, and release management.  Network tool ecosystem (as applicable): Cisco SD‑WAN Manager (vManage), Cisco ISE, Cisco FMC/CDO, Meraki Dashboard, Arista CloudVision, F5 BIG‑IQ, InfoBlox Gridmaster, logging/telemetry tools.  Automation support tooling: API clients, REST/SOAP integrations, JSON/YAML, scripting utilities.    Required Skills & Experience   8+ years of network engineering / network operations experience with strong troubleshooting background.  Hands‑on experience building automation workflows on iTential (or equivalent orchestration platform) and operating them in production.  Strong understanding of enterprise networking: routing & switching, WAN/SD‑WAN, wireless, security fundamentals, and load balancing concepts.  Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean code practices, debugging, structured logging, and error handling.  Experience integrating enterprise platforms via APIs (REST preferred) and handling authentication/authorization patterns.  Experience with version control and DevOps practices using Bitbucket (Git), including branching, PR reviews, and release tagging.  Experience with ITIL/ITSM processes and integrating automation into controlled change/incident workflows via ServiceNow.  Ability to work in a global delivery model and support rotational/on‑call needs when required.    Preferred Certifications   Cisco certifications (CCNP preferred; CCNA acceptable depending on experience).  Automation / DevOps / Cloud networking certifications are a plus.    Soft Skills   Strong communication and stakeholder management; ability to explain automation outcomes and risks clearly. Confira a oportunidade para Tech Support Level 1 Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Visual intelligence for a world uninterrupted.  Formerly Bosch Video Systems  Our promise.  We’re laser focused on creating AI-enabled video security solutions that outsmart every potential threat to your safety and security. AI is tipping the value proposition of video surveillance away from detection to delivering visual intelligence that enables proactive responses. With our ongoing investments in edge and cloud AI, we’re continuing to enhance the capabilities of our cameras, data capture, and cloud services to bring users more value.   About the role.  We are looking for a Tech Support Level 1  professional to provide technical assistance and first-line support to customers in Brazil. This role is responsible for supporting technical issues with quality, agility, and customer focus, while ensuring proper troubleshooting and escalation processes.  Mission.  Support our customers on technical issues with the expected level of quality and agility.  Key responsibilities.  Serve as the first-line contact for Brazilian SI and DI customers Perform basic configuration and support for IP cameras Interpret video analytics and manage events Configure video stream settings, resolution, FPS, and video compression Perform initial troubleshooting for cameras, lenses, infrared systems, and network connectivity Manage and follow up on technical support tickets Provide remote support to system integrators and field teams Register and configure devices on remote platforms Escalate incidents appropriately to L2/L3 support teams   Technical skills.  Knowledge of IP CCTV systems Understanding of TCP/IP networks, DHCP, DNS, and IP addressing Basic knowledge of PoE switches and device power supply Basic knowledge and support for market-leading VMS platforms Knowledge of video storage solutions, iSCSI, and recording servers Ability to read and interpret datasheets and technical manuals in English Basic knowledge of network protocols, firewall concepts, and wireless networks Knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office package Basic knowledge of SQL databases Basic knowledge of Cybersecurity applied to electronic security systems   Soft skills.  Strong verbal and written communication skills Organized and detail-oriented profile Troubleshooting and problem-solving mindset Teamwork and collaboration skills Proactive attitude and ability to manage priorities   Experience and qualification.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Networks), Systems Analysis, Computer Science, or related fields 1–3 years of experience in the Security or IT industry Intermediate English level

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Care Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.   DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.   About The Job  The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.   This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.   Working Tasks and Responsibilities  Supporting all post-sales activities. Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations. Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads. Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information. Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met. Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment. Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.  Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory. Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed. Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system. You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.   What You’ll Bring  Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable. Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures. Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.   Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.  At DEIF, we are Winning Together!  We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.  We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.  Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at

title: Food Safety Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Food Safety Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the role   Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Food Safety e Qualidade  para atuar diretamente na operação da fábrica, com forte presença no chão de fábrica e responsabilidade sobre a gestão da equipe e dos processos críticos de qualidade e segurança de alimentos. Este papel é estratégico para garantir a redução de riscos, prevenção de contaminações, gestão de crises e atendimento a auditorias , além de fortalecer a cultura de qualidade na planta. A posição requer um perfil técnico sólido aliado à capacidade de liderança e execução no dia a dia.  Key responsibilities  Liderar a área de Qualidade e Food Safety  na planta, garantindo conformidade com padrões internos e regulatórios. Atuar diretamente no chão de fábrica , assegurando a execução das práticas de qualidade e segurança de alimentos no dia a dia. Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe, atualmente composta por cerca de 10 pessoas.  Reduzir o índice de reclamações de clientes , atuando na análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas. Prevenir contaminações  por meio do fortalecimento de práticas de: Sanitização e Design sanitário Liderar a gestão de crises e situações críticas , incluindo recalls e incidentes com clientes. Atuar em interface constante com: Serviço ao cliente,  Áreas internas e stakeholders globais Conduzir e suportar auditorias de clientes e órgãos reguladores  (ANVISA, MAPA). Garantir que a operação esteja preparada para inspeções e auditorias externas. Participar de reuniões globais de qualidade , visitas e interações com stakeholders internacionais (comunicação em inglês). Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de qualidade e segurança de alimentos. Atuar como agente de mudança na área, fortalecendo estrutura, cultura e estabilidade da equipe.   Qualifications and skills  Formação superior em: Química, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas Experiência mínima de 5 anos como gerente em qualidade, food safety ou areas correlatas  na indústria de alimentos. Forte conhecimento técnico em: Food Safety e sistemas de Qualidade Experiência prática na gestão de Problemas operacionais, situações críticas e crises Vivência comprovada com: Auditorias externas e órgãos reguladores (ANVISA, MAPA) Experiência em empresas de grande porte Forte capacidade de: Trabalho em equipe, Formação e desenvolvimento de times Alta capacidade de execução, resiliente e orientado a resultados. Inglês avançado (obrigatório)

title: Projetista
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Projetista em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Buscamos um profissional atento aos detalhes, organizado e com conhecimento em Promob Studio para atuar na conferência e implantação de projetos. Será responsável por analisar os projetos dos clientes, identificar possíveis inconsistências antes da produção e garantir a correta implantação no sistema. Valorizamos profissionais com perfil analítico, comprometimento com qualidade, boa capacidade de concentração e foco na prevenção de erros e eficiência dos processos.  Responsabilidades e atribuições:    Realizar a conferência técnica dos projetos desenvolvidos no Promob Studio, garantindo que estejam de acordo com os padrões e requisitos de produção. Identificar inconsistências, divergências ou possíveis erros nos projetos antes da liberação Realizar ajustes e correções necessárias nos projetos em alinhamento com as áreas responsáveis. Garantir a padronização dos cadastros e processos relacionados à implantação dos projetos. Acompanhar pendências e tratativas para evitar impactos nos prazos de produção. Manter registros e controles atualizados sobre projetos implantados e ajustes realizados. Contribuir com sugestões de melhoria nos processos de conferência e implantação, visando redução de erros e aumento da eficiência operacional.   Requisitos e qualificações:   Curso de PROMOB;  Experiência comprojeto de móveis;  Excel Intermediário Ensino Médio Completo

Todos os dias somos inspirados pelo nosso propósito: «desenvolvemos capacidades únicas que transformam recursos em vida e progresso», criando produtos da mais alta qualidade que geram valor para indústrias estratégicas como a saúde, a tecnologia e a alimentação. Este cargo tem como objetivo otimizar a execução logística e comercial, fortalecer a governança dos processos e promover a satisfação do cliente, por meio de uma gestão proativa da carteira de pedidos, comunicação transparente e melhoria contínua da eficiência operacional.   Principais Responsabilidades  Acompanhamento completo do ciclo do pedido, desde a entrada no Salesforce até o faturamento e despacho, monitorando aprovações, status e possíveis desvios do processo. Coordenação direta com clientes para alinhamento e programação de entregas, garantindo comunicação clara e previsibilidade dos embarques.Interface entre as áreas Comercial, Operações, Logística e Supply Chain para planejamento e execução dos despachos. Confirmação de carregamentos e acompanhamento das entregas junto aos clientes. Gestão da carteira de pedidos, monitorando saldos, prioridades, alocação de estoque e faturamento. Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e acompanhamento ativo de clientes para programação de retiradas e entregas. Suporte ao atendimento de clientes industriais, realizando o planejamento das entregas de negociações concluídas e levantamento contínuo de demandas. Gestão e acompanhamento de reclamações de clientes, atuando na identificação de causas e implementação de ações corretivas. Governança de pedidos, exceções e prioridades comerciais, assegurando alinhamento entre as áreas envolvidas e redução de retrabalho. Atuação direta na otimização do nível de serviço, balanceamento de estoques e aumento da eficiência operacional. Fortalecimento da governança comercial e da previsibilidade da execução, contribuindo para maior assertividade no planejamento e acompanhamento dos resultados. Coordenação com Logística, Fábricas e Supply Chain para garantir continuidade do abastecimento, previsibilidade das entregas e menor dependência de intervenções comerciais emergenciais.    Requisitos do Cargo:  Ensino superior completo em Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins;  Experiência prévia em Customer Care, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logística ou Gestão de Pedidos;  Conhecimento emprocessos de atendimento ao cliente, gestão de carteira de pedidos, faturamento, programação de entregas e interação com áreas operacionais;  Experiência desejável com sistemas ERP (SAP, Odoo ou similares) e Salesforce;  Conhecimento deespanhol será considerado um diferencial, devido à interação com equipes internacionais.

Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.    Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

 maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.Make timely, data-driven decisions.Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.Other duties as assigned.Required Education and Experience:Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets. About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here! As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently, using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines, contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.G., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Requisitos: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Mais de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou suporte em produção. Suporte em Produção & Diagnóstico (Crítico): Experiência sólida em ambientes de suporte L2/L3 (preferencialmente além de experiência apenas em projetos);  Excelentes habilidades de diagnóstico e troubleshooting em sistemas distribuídos complexos;  Experiência comprovada em ambientes operacionais reativos (ex: call center, operações de campo, plataformas voltadas ao cliente). Tecnologia & Sistemas: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, logging ou observabilidade em ambientes produtivos;  Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos com sistemas modernos e legados;  Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365 e Power Platform (foco em troubleshooting, não desenvolvimento principal);  Experiência com arquiteturas de integração (REST APIs, GraphQL, sistemas orientados a eventos);  Conhecimento em aplicações mobile (iOS/Android) e sistemas operacionais como telefonia ou field service;  Visão ampla de aplicações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança em sistemas distribuídos;  Familiaridadecom ferramentas DevOps e ambientes múltiplos (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod). Diferenciais: Experiência com Dynamics 365 em produção;  Experiência em plataformas globais e multi-país;  Experiência com modelos de entrega envolvendo integradores de sistema (SI). Idioma: Inglês fundamental nível avançado. Por que se juntar a nós? Atuará de forma central na transformação de um dos principais domínios de produto e da maior operação global da empresa;  Trabalhará emmudançasde alto impacto, em escala global;  Colaborará com stakeholders seniores, líderes de produto e especialistas técnicos globais;  Oportunidade de equilibrar entrega prática (hands-on) com transformação de longo prazo. O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;  Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.Js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

description:

Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) Your day at NTT DATA A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas! Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan What You'll Be Doing Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas) Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto Quais serão suas responsabilidades? Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);  Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);  Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;  Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;  Trabalhar comtimes deinfraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;  Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;  Apoiar troubleshooting de replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração. O que esperamos que você possua? Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;  Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift;  Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados;  Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount;  Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;  Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;  Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;  Capacidade deatuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos. The Cyber Advisor – Specialist in Data & AI Security provides specialized cybersecurity and governance expertise across BRP’s data analytics program, information management, and AI ecosystems. This role acts as a trusted partner to the Data Analytics, AI, and Data Governance teams, ensuring that data is securely designed, processed, and managed in alignment with BRP’s Information Security framework, privacy obligations, and regulatory requirements (e.G., GDPR, SOx, NIS2). The advisor bridges cybersecurity, data governance, and technology architecture, helping to embed security‑by‑design principles and responsible AI practices across the enterprise. ResponsibilitiesServe as the primary cybersecurity advisor for all Data, Analytics, and AI initiatives. Partner with Data Governance and Information Management teams to ensure that policies, data classifications, and lifecycle controls are effectively applied. Provide security‑by‑design guidance for data platforms, data lakes, pipelines, and AI/ML environments. Ensure proper data access, encryption, anonymization, and retention practices are implemented consistently across systems. Evaluate and strengthen data security controls within Snowflake, Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, and related platforms. Review data access models, role‑based permissions, and segregation of duties (SoD) for analytics and reporting environments. Collaborate with the Enterprise Architecture and Cloud Security teams to align data architectures with BRP’s cybersecurity standards. Support TPRM assessments for vendors and platforms handling sensitive or AI‑related data. Participate in the Data Governance Committee, providing cybersecurity insight on classification, privacy, and compliance matters. Support incident response and forensic investigations for data‑related or AI system security events. Develop and deliver awareness sessions for data and AI teams on secure data management, privacy‑by‑design, and ethical AI. Contribute to the creation and continuous improvement of BRP’s Data and AI Security Standards.  QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focused on data security, data governance, or AI systems. Strong understanding of data governance and information management principles (data ownership, lineage, metadata, quality, retention). Proven expertise with Snowflake and other database or analytics platforms (e.G., Databricks, Azure Synapse, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI). Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (Azure AI, OpenAI, TensorFlow, etc.) and their security implications. Knowledge of cloud security architectures across Azure, AWS, and GCP. Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, GDPR, SOx, EU AI Act, and NIST AI RMF. Excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate complex technical risks to non‑technical audiences.  Key AttributesStrategic and analytical thinker with strong data security acumen. Deep understanding of how cybersecurity intersects with data governance and AI innovation. Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable in a fast‑evolving digital environment. Passionate about secure and ethical use of data and AI technologies.  Location: Campinas, Brazil. Hybrid work: 2 to 3 days in the office. Resumes in English will be preferred. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Conduzir experimentos, realizando a coleta, tratamento e preparação dos dados necessários para a modelagem. Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de IA para diversas tarefas, como classificação e análise preditiva. Conhecimento em big data e integração de modelos com aplicações reais. Domínio de técnicas de otimização e avaliação de modelos. Experiência prática com o ecossistema de desenvolvimento de LLMs, especialmente com LangChain e/ou LangGraph. Conhecimento abrangente sobre a arquitetura e o funcionamento de LLMs e modelos de fundação (Transformers, Attention, etc.) e familiaridade com a API e as capacidades de modelos diversos (GPTs, Geminis, Claude, Llama, etc.). Experiência com frameworks de agentes como CrewAI ou AutoGen. Experiência com otimização de LLMs (quantização, poda, etc.) para inferência eficiente. Contribuições para a comunidade open-source (projetos, artigos, etc.) na área de IA.  O CPQD oferece:Auxílio creche ou babá. Assistência médica Sulamérica. Assistência odontológica Uniodonto. Auxílio medicamento Vidalink. Vale refeição/alimentação. Seguro de vida. Plano de saúde Pet. Gratificação de férias acima da prática do mercado. Previdência Privada. WellHub. Fretado. Estacionamento gratuito. Crédito consignado. Day off no mês do aniversário. Emenda de feriados. Empresa cidadã: licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas. Programa de apoio à Pós-Graduação. Parcerias e convênios: facilitando opções de saúde, lazer, cultura e educação. Programas internos: com foco em desenvolvimento e bem estar.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM  Location : Campinas, Brazil  Role Overview   We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation  and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.  Key Responsibilities   Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.   Required Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience  in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.   Preferred Qualifications   Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.   Soft Skills   Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.   About Acceleronix   Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.  Life at Acceleronix LATAM   At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development   Industries & Applications   Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security   Why Acceleronix LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus —  Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —  Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —  Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —  Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —  Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.   Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)   Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources   We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.
